subject: RE: Madrid dinner + unified ML pipelines
text:
Hi [NAME],

Wanted to quickly send a message. We're going to be hosting two dinners for
the Spanish AI community in November (Madrid and Barcelona) and I wanted to
see if you'd be interested in joining?

Background on who we are / who attends these things. Encord unfies a
significant amount of the ML tech stake (Visualisation, curation,
annotation, eval etc) and the majority of our clients have built these
in-house and moved over as the breadth of projects has changed or the scale
of data has. We're working with a lot of the leading broadcast AI groups
among many other verticals and that means our events are typically Head of
CV/ML, Data leadership and CTO's.

I'd love to hear what you're doing at Nielsen IQ and give you more
background on the event itself. Would you be free today or tomorrow for a
15 mins chat?

subject: Physical AI Mixer @ Actuate - SF, 23rd Sept
text:

subject: Annotation throughput - Video AI
text:
Hi [NAME],

My colleague was in touch with Chris Hall and it sounded like increasing labelling throughput + more comprehensive modality support for VLM (syncing video, audio & text) were potential areas of improvement for [COMPANY]. So I wanted to introduce myself as your point of contact at Encord - a unified data development platform for curation, annotation & dataset evaluation for video AI teams.

We've onboarded physical security companies like Flock Safety, Milestone Systems & LVT from first-gen/ open source tools like CVAT, Voxel51 or Vertex AI. By moving to our integrated platform they were able to 6x annotation throughput.

For teams with in-house labelling workforce, our auto-annotation and organizational analytics help redirect manual efforts on label/ caption correction, resulting in more consistent datasets with up to 30% improvement in annotation accuracy.

Would you be open to see if there are avenues to similar outcomes at [COMPANY]? We're flexible morning times MT for a quick chat.
